body: Current frontier LLMs can theoretically process long contexts with 1M tokens or more. But to what extent can they go beyond simple retrieval and perform deeper reasoning over such long contexts? We empirically investigate long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LLMs, focusing on deductive logic expressed in Prolog. We construct ProloNg, a synthetic testbed to probe Prolog Long Reasoning, which systematically varies the complexity (reasoning depth) of problems, where the hardest case has a reasoning depth of 22 and 62k context length. We study 8 reasoning models across 5 families of frontier LLMs, and find that performance degrades substantially as reasoning depth grows, with the majority of models approaching chance beyond depth 10.
summaryZh: 该研究旨在探索当前前沿大型语言模型（LLM）在处理超长上下文（如1M tokens）时，超越简单检索能力并进行深度推理的程度。研究人员构建了一个名为ProloNg的合成测试平台，专门用于探测LLM在演绎逻辑（以Prolog语言表示）方面的长距离推理能力。该平台系统性地调整了问题的复杂性，特别是推理深度，最难的情况推理深度达到22，上下文长度为62k。通过对来自五个系列的八种前沿LLM进行测试，研究发现随着推理深度的增加，模型性能显著下降，大多数模型在推理深度超过10后接近随机猜测水平。
